_comment: Shared camera framing config. Single source of truth for pixel boxes referenced by main.py (classifier crop, public display crop) and run_second_opinion.py (SpeciesNet crop). Checked into git deliberately - these are not secrets, and losing git-blame history on coordinate changes was worse than the alternative. prudynt.json's motion ROI on the camera itself is a separate system and is NOT read from here - it has to be updated by hand over SSH when this changes.
